sub: How much land each crop covers on the registered farms, where it is grown and how much harvest to expect. Adding or renaming crops comes when the server's crop list is ready.
none_title: No crop is painted on any farm yet
none_text: Crops appear when farmers paint them on their fields in the app.
no_land: No land of this crop yet.
estimate_note: Harvest is an estimate: dunam × a typical harvest per dunam. It is not a measurement.
soon_title: Adding and editing crops is coming soon
